base_prompt: Create an oil painting on canvas.

style_clauses.monet: In the style of Claude Monet.
style_clauses.cezanne: In the style of Paul Cézanne.

polarity_clauses.muted: Use a muted, low-chroma palette throughout the painting.
polarity_clauses.vivid: Use a vivid, high-chroma palette throughout the painting.

closing_prompt: Preserve the described scene layout. Render only the painting area, without a surrounding frame, signature, letters or watermark.

templates.scene_text: A quiet river crosses an outdoor landscape. Tree-lined banks flank an open stretch of water, with the far bank visible behind it.
A river bends past a low grassy bank. A few trees stand behind the near bank, while the water and distant bank remain clearly visible.
Several houses stand on a village slope. A path passes between the buildings, with a few trees and open countryside beyond them.
A small group of houses borders an outdoor lane. The lane recedes between the buildings toward trees in the distance.
Open fields extend across a rural landscape. A narrow path crosses the foreground, with a line of trees along the distant edge of the fields.
An outdoor garden occupies a gently sloping field. A footpath separates low vegetation, with several trees beyond the planted area.
